title: Sync never removes/deactivates accounts deleted in Firefly
description: syncAccounts.ts only upserts accounts returned by Firefly's /accounts endpoint. If an account is deleted in Firefly (rather than toggled inactive), the local row is never touched again and keeps its last-known active=true state and stale balance forever, so it keeps showing in net worth and gets summed into every future net worth snapshot (snapshotNetWorth.ts, backfillNetWorth.ts also lacked the active filter). Root cause of user report: closed/deleted a liability in Firefly, still showed up in Ember net worth after resync.
close_reason: syncAccounts.ts now deactivates local account rows not present in Firefly's current /accounts response (soft-delete, preserves FK'd transaction history). Also added the active filter to snapshotNetWorth.ts and backfillNetWorth.ts, which had the same gap as getNetWorth.ts.

title: CI Docker build fails: pnpm 11 ignores package.json onlyBuiltDependencies
description: Dockerfile uses 'corepack enable pnpm' with no version pin, so it picks up latest pnpm (11.x) via corepack. pnpm 11 no longer reads the 'pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies' field in package.json (renamed to 'allowBuilds' and moved to pnpm-workspace.yaml). Without it, pnpm 11 hard-fails frozen-lockfile installs with [ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS] for esbuild's postinstall script, breaking the GitHub Actions Docker build. Reproduced locally with 'docker build --target backend-builder .' and 'docker build --target frontend-builder .'
close_reason: Added pnpm-workspace.yaml with allowBuilds:esbuild to backend/ and frontend/, updated Dockerfile COPY steps to include it, removed dead pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies from backend/package.json. Verified with full docker build.

title: Net worth includes closed/inactive Firefly accounts
description: getNetWorth.ts queries all asset/liability accounts by type but never filters on the active flag (already synced from Firefly's active field). Closing/ending an account in Firefly still leaves it counted in net worth and listed in the dashboard until it's deleted outright.
